Christopher Marlowe, The Jew of Malta, edited by Havelock Ellis.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/christopher-marlowe/the-jew-of-malta

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Christopher Marlowe, the author, died 1593.
- Havelock Ellis, the editor, died 1939.

First publication of the text used: 1589 (SE colophon: 'The Jew of Malta was published in 1589 by Christopher Marlowe.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1589, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1684.
- Country of origin (England, part of the United Kingdom today, where the text was first published): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die did so in 1939, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 2010.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
